title: ComponentSpec
description: modules/fm-web -- a UI component's own props/states/accessibility contract, produced by the frontend agent (19 §19.1's own 'UX-heavy templates' row). Front matter fields mirror @forge/schemas' own baseFrontMatterShape convention (packages/schemas/src/registry/front-matter.ts) field-for-field, EXCEPT created/updated: baseFrontMatterShape's own created/updated are a bare date because a workflow's own logic sets them, but this type's own template (templates/component-spec.md.hbs) renders them directly from 19 §19.2's own real TemplateContext.now, which @forge/core's own real Clock.now() (packages/core/src/clock.ts) documents as a full ISO-8601 instant, not a bare date -- a critic round rendered the template with a real instant value and confirmed a bare-date schema rejects it outright. created/updated are therefore date-time here, not date. This type is not registered in @forge/schemas' own registry -- see modules/fm-web/module.yaml's own header comment and SPEC-QUESTIONS.md Q157 for why a new, module-owned artifact type was the right call here rather than reusing an existing registry type.

component_name.description: the component's own real name, e.g. PriceTag

props.description: one entry per public prop the component accepts

states.description: the distinct visual/interaction states the component can be in

accessibility_notes.description: concrete a11y requirements this component must satisfy (aria roles, focus order, contrast, ...)
